correctness.rationale: For every ordered x,y from the 27 ternary length-three words, construct the two nontrivial splices and forbid each z at Hamming distance 0 or 1 from either splice. I independently rebuilt the 27x27 forbidden-bit-mask table directly from this quantified definition. Exhaustion of all 80,730 five-subsets finds none valid; by heredity no larger code is valid. Exhaustion of all 17,550 four-subsets gives exactly nine labeled maxima; independent construction of C_{j,b} (fix one position to b, prohibit b elsewhere) matches all nine. Simultaneous alphabet permutations (S3) and reversal (C2) give two orbits of sizes 3 and 6, stabilizers 4 and 2; source census.json explicitly lists all nine and its cardinality/first rows were inspected. This is a complete finite proof, not a sample or extrapolation.
